summary: Limbach Holdings filed an 8-K reporting that subsidiary Limbach Facility Services LLC entered a new $300 million PNC Credit Agreement dated September 9, 2026, maturing September 9, 2031, replacing its Wheaton Bank & Trust facility. The package comprises a $200 million revolver (with $20 million swingline and $25 million letter of credit subfacilities), a $50 million term loan, and a $50 million delayed draw term loan, plus an accordion of the greater of $150 million or 100% of Consolidated EBITDA. Pricing is Base Rate plus 0.50%–1.50% or Term SOFR plus 1.50%–2.50%, leverage-based, with 0.20%–0.35% commitment fees. This is a routine financing, not a special situation.
